definition: agreement between the MAFFT and MUSCLE alignments of the same derivation set, as median column entropy and column count
measured_value: median entropy MAFFT 1.00-2.18 vs MUSCLE 0.92-1.74 across the 7 families; column counts differ by 5-34 percent
why: a direct two-method comparison. It measures METHOD SENSITIVITY, not homology: two aligners agreeing does not make a column homologous, and disagreeing does not make it non-homologous
allowable_claim: alignment stability, per family, naming both methods
prohibited_phrasing: must not be called homology evidence
denominator: columns in that family's derivation alignment

definition: per column: gap fraction, Shannon entropy, modal residue fraction, context entropy, entropy delta vs MUSCLE
measured_value: top 40 columns per family landed, ranked continuously
why: NO PASS THRESHOLD IS APPLIED. The previous round's 90 percent bar was chosen after seeing the distribution and was correctly rejected; g4a ranks and does not cut
allowable_claim: candidate anchors ranked by evidence, described qualitatively
prohibited_phrasing: no column may be called AN ANCHOR on a g4a threshold, because g4a declares none

definition: whether the [YF]xDD in family A's profile consensus aligns to the [YF]xDD in family B's
measured_value: 42 of 42 ordered pairs DYAD_CORRESPONDS at aligned-column offset 0; exactly one dyad motif per consensus in every family
why: read DIRECTLY from the hhalign consensus alignment, reimplementing nothing. This is the single strongest positive result of g4a
allowable_claim: the catalytic dyad is a cross-family homologous anchor, recovered de novo without any myRT or Pfam profile
prohibited_phrasing: must not be extended to any other motif without the same test

definition: hhalign probability, E-value, score and aligned-column count between de novo profiles
measured_value: all 42 ordered pairs align; probability 74.2-100.0; best E-value 4.8e-42
why: profiles built only from g4a derivation alignments of full-length-source proteins
allowable_claim: between-family correspondence is supported for every pair tested
prohibited_phrasing: a high hhalign probability is profile similarity, not proof of positional homology at any single column

definition: for A to B to C versus A to C, the fraction of positions mapping within +/-2
measured_value: 210 testable triples; mean 88.2 percent consistent; 174 of 210 (83 percent) at or above 80 percent; median offset 0
why: transitivity is the cheapest available check that pairwise correspondences describe one coherent coordinate system rather than 42 unrelated alignments
allowable_claim: transitive consistency of the pairwise correspondences
denominator: 210 triples with at least 20 testable positions

definition: per family, consensus positions aligned to ALL 6 partners (GLOBAL_CANDIDATE), to 2-5 (CLASS_LEVEL), to exactly 1 (FAMILY_LEVEL)
measured_value: GLOBAL 68-160 positions per family; pct_global 18.9 (UG5) to 57.3 (CRISPR); pct_global_or_class 69.1 (UG3) to 99.6 (CRISPR)
why: the primary g4a output. It emerges from the pairwise data; no target number of regions was set
allowable_claim: the size and extent of the empirically supported shared core
prohibited_phrasing: must not be described as a number of regions, domains or subdomains
denominator: positions aligned to at least one partner

definition: the consensus-index span occupied by GLOBAL_CANDIDATE positions
measured_value: spans of 94-201 consensus positions; 64.2-87.3 percent of each span is global
why: shows the shared core is contiguous-ish rather than scattered
allowable_claim: the extent of the shared core in each family's own coordinates
prohibited_phrasing: no residue-level boundary is implied by a span
denominator: the span between the first and last global position

quantity: transfer to withheld challenge sequences, as a SCORE
definition: median best bit score of a family's de novo profile against held-out challenge sequences
measured_value: SELF median 424.1, CROSS median 32.6 - a 13.0x separation. Weakest: UG5 profile on AbiA challenge (median -1.1), GII on UG5 (0.3)
allowable_claim: family profiles are strongly family-specific, and cross-family signal is weak but mostly non-zero
prohibited_phrasing: must not be called accuracy or validation

definition: fraction of challenge sequences detected at hmmsearch --max -E 10
why: FLAGGED IN THE TABLE ITSELF as NON_DISCRIMINATING. At --max -E 10 essentially every RT is detected by essentially every RT profile, so the rate cannot fail and carries almost no information. It is retained for completeness and must not be quoted as evidence of transfer
prohibited_phrasing: this rate may not be presented as transfer performance

definition: whether a challenge sequence's own family profile was built without it
measured_value: YES by construction - whole cd-hit clusters at 0.50 were assigned to roles, so no challenge sequence has a >=50 percent identity relative inside derivation
why: the previous review's objection was that a held-out FAMILY is not held out while its myRT profile survives. g4a builds every profile itself from derivation sequences only, so there is no external profile to leak
prohibited_phrasing: a held-out FAMILY is still not tested here: every family contributes a profile. Only SEQUENCES are held out

definition: whether a family genuinely lacks a feature
true start and end of any region
mapping a family never seen in derivation
why: all 7 families contribute a derivation profile, so no family is withheld. Testing this needs an 8th family held out entirely, which g4a did not do

quantity: N-terminal sequence outside the inferred core
definition: residues N-terminal to the first globally supported consensus position
why: the global core spans are landed per family, so this is computable, but it was not predeclared and is not reported here rather than being added after seeing the results
prohibited_phrasing: no RT0 label on any N-terminal sequence
